notes.title: Updates with the name of the game, monetization, and what's coming next.
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45233008/308318f472ac2d98ca9976d0475b21c754f6792e.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]It’s been a while, but we’re finally back with some updates![/p][p][/p][p]1) [b]Paw Rescuers[/b] is now [b]Tenkemo![/b][/p][p]It turns out there are scammers out there who made a fake website with the name of our game, pretending to be us, and convincing people to download the beta version of the game (a virus) from their site.[/p][p]We also weren’t sure if the name [i]Paw Rescuers[/i] really described the game well, since it’s more about exploration and open-world co-op adventure, while the name made it sound like it was only about rescuing animals.[/p][p]So we thought it would be the right thing to rename the game at this stage, and call it [i]Tenkemo[/i]! (please don’t ask what it means, since we don’t know ourselves =).[/p][p]And yesss, we bought the tenkemo.com domain, so scammers will have to be more creative this time.👉 Please remember that we will make announcements only on our official platforms — Steam, Discord, X, etc.[/p][p][/p][p]2) [b]Tenkemo[/b] will be paid on Steam, without free 2 play monetization elements.[/p][p]The game was initially planned only for mobile (iOS/Android) with a free-to-play monetization model.[/p][p]At first, we decided to keep the same model for Steam too, and since it was our first PC/Steam game, we had no idea that people hate in-app purchases/free-to-play elements here (for a good reason hehe), especially for a game that has a single-player/story mode.[/p][p]So we’ve decided to make the game paid, with a reasonable price, and get rid of all the free-to-play elements.[/p][p]If you’ve wishlisted the game thinking it would be free and got disappointed by this news, and are unable to purchase the game, don’t worry — please reach us on Discord, and we’ll make sure to give you a free copy when the game comes out.[/p][p][/p][p]3) There have been a lot of changes in the game during this period. We have a new trailer and screenshots that you can check out on the Steam page.[/p][p]We will also be participating at [b]DevGAMM Lisbon[/b], where you can visit us and try out the game! Since we already have a playable version, we are now working on polishing it and bringing it to Early Access in the coming months![/p][p]We’ll post another update here on Steam once Early Access is ready.[/p][p][/p][p]Looks like that's all! If you've got any questions please feel free to ask here, or on our Discord channel =)[/p]
